title: 第14章 我本是太子，皇位凭什么争不得
slug: 刚成仙神子孙求我出山
content_zh:
魔门入京？
姜长生并没有担忧，而是问道：“鬼目邪王实力在魔门内排第几？”
陈礼回答道：“魔门除了门主外，有两位副门主，再往下便是七大邪王、十八使者，鬼目邪王至少是排在前五的存在，之前袭击龙起观时，他被关天牢，伤势严重，实力其实不如巅峰时的一半，天牢的那些手段即便是武林高手也难以承受。”
这就前五了？
姜长生开始期待魔门的来袭，当然，面对魔门高手，他不会掉以轻心。
必须全力以赴，不能养成懈怠的心理，对待任何一名敌人，都要尽可能快的将其击杀。
姜长生在心里告诫自己，眼神变得坚定。
陈礼见他眼神变化，以为他害怕了，道：“若是你担心，可以暂住我陈家，魔门再强势，必然也不敢袭击尚书府邸。”
姜长生摇头道：“多谢好意，为了龙起观，我也得留下，放心吧。”
陈礼抚须笑道：“也是，四年前你就能击毙鬼目邪王，如今的你得多强？啧啧，不敢想象啊。”
姜长生谦虚回应，陈礼开始说起其他话题。
先说江湖事，今年年初江湖上出了一名少年天才，十六岁之龄练就神功，踏入绝顶之资，如今更是成为一教之主，此教改名为归元神教！
大景朝重武，如此少年英才自然得朝堂权贵的青睐，据说超过十支氏族已经派人去拉拢归元神教的教主。
陈礼轻蔑道：“在我看来，真正的少年天才是你啊，长生，任何天才在你面前都黯然失色。”
姜长生摇头失笑：“我可不想当什么天才，只想在山上体验岁月静好。”
“岁月静好……好一个岁月静好！”
陈礼赞叹道，自从姜长生手里多了拂尘后，他便觉得这小子越发的出尘，甚至比清虚道长还要仙风道骨，世间若有少年仙人，当是如此。
聊着聊着，陈礼又开始妄议朝政，疯狂吐槽皇帝。
姜长生都怀疑他要造反。
虽然姜渊亏待姜长生，但这天下是姜家的，姜长生自然不会助他人推翻自己家的江山。

聊了半个时辰，陈礼告辞离去，临走之前，姜长生拿出几张纸，上面写着各种药材，希望陈礼能帮忙寻找，陈礼直接接下，表示会尽力。
姜长生准备炼制驻颜丹与魔门毒药的解药，之前二皇子姜明送过不少药材，但远远不够。
炼丹术配上春秋医典，当真是绝配，春秋医典上有许多药方，不过涉及修仙的不多，也就寥寥几种，其中便包括驻颜丹。
姜长生可不想苍老的度过长生。
夜幕降临，姜长生继续练功。
白龙爬到窗台前，静静的望着月亮，月光的照耀下，它的蛇身散发着淡淡荧光。
次日，被幻神瞳篡改记忆的两位道童前来，姜长生对他们心中有愧，所以便将气指传授于他们。
气指虽是陈家的武学，但陈礼并没有让他不得外传。
就这样，这两位小道童时常来拜访姜长生，姜长生还为他们赐名，男的名为万里，女的名为明月。
又是一年秋季到来。
因皇帝离去，京城变得比以往更加热闹，来往的商贾、镖队也比以往更多，当然，案件也更多。
近来前往京城衙门当差的陈礼倍感疲惫，他还没到三十岁，却也有四十多岁的沧桑，主要是体现在头发上，白发过半，眉宇间尽是忧虑之色。
姜长生很担心他会猝死，但也没办法劝。
“杨家与洪家在明争暗斗，各自拉拢文武官员，甚至还拉拢江湖高手，这京城看来要爆发一场纷争，或许魔门便是由他们引来，借着魔门复仇的由头，趁机干掉自己的对手。”
陈礼叹气道，忧心忡忡。
姜长生道：“那陈家可得小心了。”
陈礼摇头道：“陈家没有站队，再加上家主乃户部尚书，六部尚书谁敢动，动的只是各派系的爪牙罢了。”
姜长生觉得在理，便没有再提醒。
这一次陈礼到来，主要是帮他送药材，上百种药材，各配了近十份，足足用两个大箱子抬上山，他给出的药方，陈礼备好了九成，可见用心程度。
陈礼说了一下京城的暗流涌动后便迅速离去。

姜长生则开始清点药材，驻颜丹的药材已经齐全，至于清虚道长的解药，还得仔细检查其伤势。
随后，姜长生离开房间，前去拜访清虚道长。
清虚道长平日里很少抛头露面，大小事务已经完全交由孟秋霜，他一直待在自己幽静的小院里，在树下静坐，不知是练功，还是在感悟人生。
姜长生来到他面前，弯腰行礼，道：“师父，近来徒儿对医术与炼丹之术有所领悟，可愿让徒儿检查你的伤势？”
清虚道长没有睁眼，而是抬起手，将袖口拉开，露出惊悚可怕的手臂，整条小臂已经完全发黑，那一根根如长虫般的血管开始发紫。
姜长生上前，仔细检查。
清虚道长开口道：“长生，近来陈礼与你的谈话可有企图？”
姜长生回答道：“没有，他每次来除了送礼，便是谈论一些杂事，没有教徒儿做事，也没有要求徒儿为他行事。”
清虚道长嗯了一声，继续道：“陈家来历复杂，在朝堂之上，不被各派系所认同，这也是为师放任他与你接触的原因，但陈家是一把双刃剑，没有把握好，可能会被他们带往深渊。”
“徒儿知晓他们在前朝为官，心里有数。”
“有数就好，从小到大，为师没有特别教你什么，但看如今的你，为师很欣慰，两位皇子拉拢你都没有成功，看来你已经有自己的想法，而非单纯的探索真相。”
清虚道长露出笑容，显得那么的慈祥。
姜长生盯着他，忍不住问道：“师父，可否跟我讲讲您与陛下的陈年故事？”
闻言，清虚道长沉默。
师徒俩之间的谈话虽没有完全点破，但彼此已然心照不宣。
“唉，当年为师还未成道士，皇帝也并非皇帝，我们是老乡，城池被攻破，我们的家人惨遭屠戮，只有我与他逃出来，世人只知我救驾有功，殊不知，在我习武之前，一直都是他保护着我……”
清虚道长睁开眼睛，望着头顶的树叶，陷入无限怀念中。
姜长生认真听着，想要了解姜渊是怎样的人。
在清虚道长的故事里，姜渊勇敢又有义气，面对绝境，敢于放手一搏，也是一位很有人格魅力的人，无论去哪儿，总能收获一批忠实的跟随者，在获得杨家的支持后，姜渊彻底起势。
不过当姜渊立国称帝后，他就变了。

“那一日，他站在皇宫里的通天台上，俯视着下方文臣武将、浩浩军队，仿佛在俯视芸芸众生，尽显皇帝霸气，我在人海之中注意到他眼神的变化，他变了，他的眼神从自豪、欣喜变得忧虑、忌惮，那时，我便知道，姜渊不在，取而代之的是欲比天高的开元大帝。”
“自古以来，皇帝都是孤家寡人，而这一点也出现在当今陛下身上，他的眼光不是当下的社稷，对皇子的期待，也绝非寻常的父子之情，他要的是天下，争的是万年。”
清虚道长说到这儿，语气之中竟流露出浓烈的钦佩之意。
姜长生听出了他的言外之意。
老道士是在帮姜渊说话！
说起来，出生十八年，姜长生就见过姜渊一面，还未真正接触过他。
清虚道长摇头笑道：“世人皆想当皇帝，哪知皇帝的不易，徒儿，若是你当皇帝，你会当怎样的皇帝？”
姜长生摇头笑道：“徒儿可不知该如何当皇帝，也不想当皇帝。”
清虚道长意味深长的看了他一眼。
故事讲完了，姜长生也检查完了，于是起身告辞。
清虚道长目送着他离去，似乎想要看穿他的内心。
姜长生背对着清虚道长，嘴角上扬。
确实让人心驰神往！
我本是太子，这皇位凭什么争不得！
姜长生心中那个疯狂的想法开始发芽。
姜渊有千般理由，万般立场，都不能愚弄他的人生！
“既然你能瞒天过海，那我也来，就看谁的手段更高明吧。”
姜长生默默想到。
道法自然功第三层便可轻松击杀绝顶高手，第四层再怎么也能跟通天高手打个平手，因为没有见过真正的通天高手，姜长生必须高估对手。
等我达到第五层，再去会会皇宫里的通天！

夏秋交际之期，京城忽然萧瑟，起因是瘟疫来袭，得病者皆是四肢发软，性情变得暴躁，若与人争吵，容易气急攻心，五脏六腑破裂，痛苦的死去。
此病爆发得极快，姜长生这段时间忙着炼制驻颜丹以及清虚道长的解药，没有出院，直到青苦告诉他，他才知道瘟疫来袭。
龙起观已经闭观，不再接客。
姜长生倒没有多想，挺过去就好，他甚至开始期待瘟疫过后的生存奖励。
这一日，他终于研制出三枚驻颜丹，他服用了一枚，从此青春长驻，长期保持在十八岁的模样。
驻颜丹的药效多长，他也不清楚，反正若是开始变化，再服用驻颜丹就好。
清虚道长的解药倒是有些麻烦，按照春秋医典的药方，目前缺一种药材，不过他不急，还有三年时间。
content_en:
The Demon Gate enters Beijing?
Jiang Changsheng was not worried, but asked: "Where does the strength of Ghost Eye Evil King rank within the Demon Sect?"
Chen Li replied: "In addition to the sect master, the Demon Sect has two deputy sect masters, followed by seven evil kings and eighteen messengers. The Ghost Eyed Evil King is at least among the top five. When he attacked Long Qiguan before, he was imprisoned in Tianlao and seriously injured. His strength is actually not half of what he was at his peak. Even martial arts masters can't bear the methods of Tianlao."
Is this the top five?
Jiang Changsheng began to look forward to the attack of the Demon Sect. Of course, he would not take it lightly when facing the masters of the Demon Sect.
You must go all out and not develop a slack mentality. When dealing with any enemy, you must kill them as quickly as possible.
Jiang Changsheng warned himself in his mind, his eyes becoming firm.
Seeing the change in his eyes, Chen Li thought he was scared and said, "If you are worried, you can stay in my Chen family temporarily. No matter how strong the Demon Sect is, they will not dare to attack the Shangshu's mansion."
Jiang Changsheng shook his head and said: "Thank you for your kindness. For the sake of Long Qiguan, I have to stay. Don't worry."
Chen Li stroked his beard and said with a smile: "That's right. You were able to kill the Ghost Eyed Evil King four years ago. How strong are you now? Tsk, tsk, I can't imagine it."
Jiang Changsheng responded modestly, and Chen Li started to talk about other topics.
Let’s talk about the martial arts first. At the beginning of this year, a young genius appeared in the martial arts world. At the age of sixteen, he practiced magical skills and reached the top level. Now he has become the leader of a sect. This sect has been renamed Guiyuan Shen Sect!
The Great Jing Dynasty emphasized martial arts, and such a young talent naturally won the favor of the powerful people in the court. It is said that more than ten clans have sent people to win over the leader of the Guiyuan Shen Sect.
Chen Li said contemptuously: "In my opinion, the real young genius is you, Changsheng. Any genius will pale in front of you."
Jiang Changsheng shook his head and laughed: "I don't want to be a genius, I just want to experience the tranquility of the years on the mountain."
"The years of peace and quiet are good... What a time of peace and quiet!"
Chen Li praised, since Jiang Changsheng had a fly whisk in his hand, he felt that this boy was becoming more and more out of the world, even more immortal than Taoist Master Qingxu. If there is a young immortal in the world, this should be the case.
As they chatted, Chen Li began to discuss government affairs and made wild remarks about the emperor.
Jiang Changsheng even suspected that he was going to rebel.
Although Jiang Yuan treated Jiang Changsheng badly, the world belonged to the Jiang family, and Jiang Changsheng would naturally not help others overthrow his family's power.
After chatting for half an hour, Chen Li said goodbye and left. Before leaving, Jiang Changsheng took out a few pieces of paper with various medicinal materials written on them, hoping that Chen Li could help find them. Chen Li accepted them directly and said that he would try his best.
Jiang Changsheng was preparing to refine the antidote for the Zhuyan Pill and the Demon Gate Poison. The second prince Jiang Ming had sent a lot of medicinal materials before, but it was far from enough.
Alchemy and the Spring and Autumn Medical Code are a perfect match. There are many prescriptions in the Spring and Autumn Medical Code, but not many involve cultivating immortals, and there are only a few, including Zhuyan Dan.
Jiang Changsheng did not want to spend his eternal life in old age.
As night fell, Jiang Changsheng continued to practice.
The white dragon climbed to the window sill and looked at the moon quietly. Under the moonlight, its snake body exuded a faint fluorescent light.
The next day, two Taoist boys whose memories had been tampered with by the Huan Shen Tong came. Jiang Changsheng felt guilty for them, so he taught them the Qi Finger.
Although Qi Finger is a martial art of the Chen family, Chen Li did not prohibit it from spreading to outsiders.
In this way, these two little Taoist boys often came to visit Jiang Changsheng, and Jiang Changsheng also gave them names, the male was named Wanli, and the female was named Mingyue.
Another autumn has arrived.
Because the emperor left, the capital became more lively than before, with more merchants and escort teams coming and going than before, and of course, there were more cases.
Chen Li, who recently went to work as a yamen official in the capital, felt very tired. He was not yet thirty, but he still had the vicissitudes of his forties, which was mainly reflected in his hair, which was more than half gray, and there was a look of worry between his brows.
Jiang Changsheng was very worried that he would die suddenly, but there was nothing he could do to persuade him.
"The Yang family and the Hong family are fighting openly and secretly., each wooed civil and military officials, and even martial arts masters. It seemed that a dispute was about to break out in the capital. Perhaps the Demon Sect was caused by them, and they took the opportunity to kill their opponents under the pretext of the Demon Sect's revenge. "
Chen Li sighed, worried.
Jiang Changsheng said: "Then the Chen family must be careful. "
Chen Li shook his head and said: "The Chen family has not taken sides, and the head of the family is the Minister of Household Affairs. Whoever dares to touch the six ministers will only be the minions of each faction. "
Jiang Changsheng thought it was reasonable, so he didn't remind him again.
This time Chen Li came mainly to help him deliver medicinal materials. There were nearly ten portions of hundreds of medicinal materials, which were carried up the mountain in two large boxes. Chen Li had prepared 90% of the prescriptions he gave, which shows how attentive he was.
Chen Li talked about the undercurrent in the capital and left quickly.
Jiang Changsheng began to count the medicinal materials. The medicinal materials for Zhuyan Dan were complete. As for the antidote for Taoist Master Qingxu, his injuries had to be carefully checked.
Afterwards, Jiang Changsheng left the room and went to visit Taoist Master Qingxu.
Taoist Master Qingxu seldom appeared in public on weekdays, and all matters large and small were completely handed over to Meng Qiu Shuang. He had been staying in his quiet courtyard, sitting quietly under the tree, whether he was practicing martial arts or comprehending life.
Jiang Changsheng came to him, bent down and saluted, and said: "Master, my disciple has recently gained some understanding of medical skills and alchemy skills. Would you like to let my disciple check your injuries? "
Taoist Master Qingxu did not open his eyes, but raised his hand and pulled open his cuffs, revealing a horrifying arm. The entire forearm had turned completely black, and the worm-like blood vessels began to turn purple.
Jiang Changsheng stepped forward and inspected it carefully.
Taoist Master Qingxu said: "Changsheng, is there any purpose behind Chen Li's recent conversation with you? "
Jiang Changsheng replied: "No, every time he comes, apart from giving gifts, he just talks about some miscellaneous things. He doesn't teach his disciples to do things, nor does he ask his disciples to do things for him. "
Taoist priest Qingxu hummed and continued: "The Chen family has a complicated origin. It is not recognized by various factions in the court. This is why I allowed him to have contact with you. However, the Chen family is a double-edged sword. If you don't grasp it well, they may be led into the abyss. "
"My disciple knows that they were officials in the previous dynasty, so he knows it well. "
"It's good to know. Growing up, my teacher didn't teach you anything in particular, but looking at you now, my teacher is very pleased. The two princes have failed to win over you. It seems that you already have your own ideas, rather than simply exploring the truth. "
Taoist priest Qingxu smiled, looking so kind.
Jiang Changsheng stared at him and couldn't help but ask: "Master, can you tell me an old story about you and His Majesty? "
Hearing this, Taoist Master Qingxu was silent.
Although the conversation between the master and the apprentice was not completely clear, they already understood each other tacitly.
"Alas, I was a teacher before I became a Taoist priest, and the emperor was not an emperor. We were fellow villagers. The city was invaded and our families were massacred. He and I were the only ones to escape. The world only knows that I saved him, but they don't know that he was the one who protected me before I started practicing martial arts..."
Taoist priest Qingxu opened his eyes, looked at the leaves above his head, and fell into infinite nostalgia.
Jiang Changsheng listened carefully, wanting to know what kind of person Jiang Yuan was.
In the story of Taoist Master Qingxu, Jiang Yuan is brave and loyal. He dares to give it a go when faced with a desperate situation. He is also a very charismatic person. No matter where he goes, he can always gain a group of loyal followers. After gaining the support of the Yang family, Jiang Yuan completely gained momentum.
But when Jiang Yuan established his country and proclaimed himself emperor, he changed.
"That day, he stood on the Tongtian Tower in the palace, looking down at the civil servants, generals, and the vast army below, as if he was looking down at all living things, showing his domineering emperor. I noticed the change in his eyes in the sea of people. He had changed. His eyes changed from pride and joy to worry and fear. At that time, I knew that Jiang Yuan was not there, and was replaced by Emperor Kaiyuan, who wanted to be as high as the sky. "
"Since ancient times, emperors have always been lonely.Human beings, and this also appears in the current His Majesty. His vision is not the current society, and his expectations for the prince are definitely not the ordinary father-son relationship. What he wants is the world, and what he wants is to fight for thousands of years. "
When Taoist Master Qingxu said this, there was a strong sense of admiration in his tone.
Jiang Changsheng heard the implication of his words.
The old Taoist priest is speaking for Jiang Yuan!
Speaking of which, eighteen years after his birth, Jiang Changsheng had met Jiang Yuan once, but had not really come into contact with him.
Taoist Master Qingxu shook his head and said with a smile: "Everyone in the world wants to be an emperor, but who knows how difficult it is to be an emperor? Disciple, if you were to be an emperor, what kind of emperor would you be?" "
Jiang Changsheng shook his head and said with a smile: "Disciple, I don't know how to be an emperor, nor do I want to be an emperor. "
Taoist priest Qingxu gave him a meaningful look.
After finishing the story, Jiang Changsheng also finished his inspection, so he stood up and left.
Taoist Priest Qingxu watched him leave, as if he wanted to see into his heart.
Jiang Changsheng turned his back to Taoist Master Qingxu and raised the corners of his mouth.
It’s truly fascinating!
I am the prince, why can't I compete for the throne?
The crazy idea in Jiang Changsheng's heart began to sprout.
Jiang Yuan has all kinds of reasons and all kinds of positions, but none of them can fool him in his life!
"Since you can hide the truth from the truth, then I will come too, let's see who has better methods. "
Jiang Changsheng thought silently.
The third level of Taoist Natural Skills can easily defeat the top masters. No matter how hard it is, the fourth level can tie him to a tie with a Tongtian master. Because he has never seen a real Tongtian master, Jiang Changsheng must overestimate his opponent.
When I reach the fifth floor, I will go and meet Tongtian in the palace!
During the social period of summer and autumn, the capital city suddenly became desolate. The cause was the plague. All those who got the disease had weak limbs and became irritable. If they quarreled with others, they would easily get angry, their internal organs would rupture, and they would die painfully.
The disease broke out very quickly. During this period, Jiang Changsheng was busy refining the Zhuyan Pill and the antidote of Taoist Qingxu. He was not discharged from the hospital. He didn't know the plague was coming until Qing Ku told him.
Longqi Temple has closed its doors and no longer accepts guests.
Jiang Changsheng didn't think too much, just get through it. He even began to look forward to the rewards of survival after the plague.
On this day, he finally developed three beauty-preserving pills. He took one, and from then on he remained youthful and remained eighteen years old for a long time.
He didn't know how long the effect of the Zhuyan Pill would be. Anyway, if it started to change, just take the Zhuyan Pill again.
Taoist Master Qingxu's antidote is a bit troublesome. According to the prescription in the Spring and Autumn Medical Code, there is currently a shortage of medicinal materials, but he is not in a hurry. He still has three years.
